verdict_reason: The new type-step tests cover the success and refusal paths, but a #SEED_ADDRESS title now claims more than it proves, the type-page set-up is copied four times, and the page-client cookies() test is filed under chooseAddressType.

todos.issue: seed-address.test.js:63 'Should send exactly the fields the add form asks, in the order it asks them' compares Object.keys(SEED_ADDRESS) with FIELDS. The add form now also asks 'What can this address be used for?' (add.njk:32 name: "roles"), and createSeedAddress adds that outside SEED_ADDRESS (seed-address.js:73). The title claims more than the assertion proves, and no test checks the seed's use against the uses the add form offers for Origin or Consignor.
todos.fix: Must: the #SEED_ADDRESS titles state only what their assertions prove, and a test fails if the seed sends a use the add form does not offer for the type it chose. One way: retitle to 'the address fields the add form asks' and add an assertion against ROLES_BY_ADDRESS_TYPE[ADDRESS_TYPES.ORIGIN_OR_CONSIGNOR].

todos.issue: seed-address.test.js:181-184, :204-206, :216-218 and :226-228 each rebuild app().get('/address-book/add/address-type').reply(HTTP_OK, page('<form></form>')) by hand, beside serveTypeStep (:47-55), which already holds that GET. Four tests copy the same set-up.
todos.fix: Must: the address-type page GET is set up in one helper that every #chooseAddressType and #seedAddress test uses. One way: split serveTypeStep into serveTypePage() and a POST reply that each test chooses, or give serveTypeStep a reply option for the POST.

todos.issue: seed-address.test.js:179 'Should hold the session cookie the chosen type was saved in, beside the cookies it started with' sits under #chooseAddressType but asserts client.cookies(), the page client's jar merging (page-client.js:11-17, :59). chooseAddressType holds no cookies. The only test of the new page-client cookies() export is filed under, and titled for, a function that does not own the behaviour.
todos.fix: Must: page-client's cookies() has its own test under a page-client describe, titled for what the client does, and the #chooseAddressType tests claim only what chooseAddressType does. One way: move the test to a new scripts/lighthouse/page-client.test.js that drives submit() against a nock reply with set-cookie.
